name: Fried Eggs (Olive Oil-basted)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Heat olive oil in a frying pan over a low-medium heat (you will break the olive oil if you heat it too much).
Crack open one egg into the pan. Let fry while basting the yolk with hot oil in order to cook the top. If the egg begins to bubble, lower the heat.
Serve, adding salt and pepper to taste.

culture.text: A fried egg is a dish made from one or more eggs which are removed from their shells, placed into a frying pan and cooked. They are traditionally eaten for breakfast or brunch in many countries but may also be served at other times of the day.
